actions.name: Spinning Edge
actions.description: Delivers an attack. Damage increases from behind.

actions.name: Shade Shift
actions.description: Dodges the next two physical attacks.

actions.name: Gust Slash
actions.description: Delivers wind damage. Combos after Spinning Edge.

actions.name: Sneak Attack
actions.description: Delivers a powerful attack from behind. Hide ignores direction.

actions.name: Hide
actions.description: Conceals the user and enables hidden attacks from any direction.

actions.name: Assassinate
actions.description: Delivers a powerful attack to an enemy near defeat.

actions.name: Steal
actions.description: Attempts to steal an item from the enemy.

actions.name: Trick Attack
actions.description: Delivers a powerful attack from the front. Hide ignores direction.

actions.name: Aeolian Edge
actions.description: Combo finisher. Damage increases from behind.

actions.name: Flee
actions.description: Greatly increases movement speed for a short time.

actions.name: Mug
actions.description: Delivers an attack and attempts to steal an item.

actions.name: Shadow Fang
actions.description: Combo attack that gradually reduces enemy HP.

actions.name: Dancing Edge
actions.description: Delivers a fourfold attack and weakens enemy defenses.

actions.name: Viper Bite
actions.description: Poisons the enemy and lowers evasion.

actions.name: Whirlwind Edge
actions.description: Delivers an attack to enemies surrounding the user.

actions.name: Ambush
actions.description: The next physical attack gains an additional strike.

actions.name: Goad
actions.description: Gradually restores TP to nearby party members.

traits.name: Dual Wield I
traits.description: Allows a second one handed weapon to be equipped.

traits.name: Enhanced Physical Attack Power I
traits.description: Increases physical attack power by eight.

traits.name: Auto Attack Speed Up I
traits.description: Reduces dagger auto attack delay by five percent.

traits.name: Dual Wield II
traits.description: Further reduces attack delay while dual wielding by two percent.

traits.name: Enhanced Shade Shift
traits.description: Shade Shift dodges one additional physical attack.

traits.name: Enhanced Sneak Attack
traits.description: Increases Sneak Attack damage by ten percent.

traits.name: Auto Attack Speed Up II
traits.description: Reduces dagger auto attack delay by an additional five percent.

traits.name: Enhanced Trick Attack
traits.description: Improves the debilitating effect of Trick Attack.

traits.name: Enhanced Debilitation
traits.description: Increases the potency of defense reducing effects.
